 On Your Side: Toyota recalls more than 300,000 vehicles due to faulty airbags 
 By KY3 Staff Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 4:37 PM CST | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SPRINGFIELD, Mo. (Edited News Release/KY3) -Toyota is recalling more than 300,000 vehicles due to the airbag inflator having the potential to rupture.
 According to the NHTSA, an airbag inflator rupture may result in sharp metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants, resulting in serious injury or death.
 The models include certain 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 IS250, 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia, and 2016-2017 4Runner vehicles equipped with certain Takata front passenger airbag inflators installed as original equipment or as replacement parts under a prior recall. 
 The inflators may rupture due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, high temperatures, and high-temperature cycling, according to the recall.
 What you can do
 Depending on the vehicle model, dealers will replace the front passenger airbag inflator or the airbag assembly, free of charge. 
 Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning December 28. Owners may contact Toyota’s customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota’s numbers for this recall are 26TB25, 26TA25, 26LB11, and 26LA11.
 For more information on the recall, click here .
